question: Please resolve the three choices explicitly left open in BUILD-BRIEF.md: (1) Which first Claude conversational-app workflow should we prioritize: a supported connector/tool connection, or user-export/upload? (2) Should the default distillation input be user/agent-supplied memory, or an explicitly configured local model? (3) May repository/conversation overrides choose private capture, exclusion, and another authorized shared pool, or only private capture/exclusion? Choose a complete combination below or specify all three in free text.
reason: BUILD-BRIEF.md explicitly preserves these three choices as open. No DECISIONS.md or recorded dashboard answers were found. Destination and distillation choices must not be inferred. A selected connector workflow still requires authoritative capability verification and independent gates; it does not authorize scraping, paid infrastructure, or automatic third-party model calls.
